import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.tree import DecisionTreeClassifier, DecisionTreeRegressor
from sklearn.ensemble import RandomForestClassifier, RandomForestRegressor
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression, LinearRegression
from sklearn.metrics import accuracy_score, mean_absolute_error, mean_squared_error, r2_score
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split, cross_val_score, StratifiedKFold, KFold
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
d = pd.read_csv("deliveries.csv",parse_dates=["created"])
ok = d[d.actual_min.between(1,299)].copy()
ok['hour']=ok.created.dt.hour
cols=['distance_km','items','promised_min','hour']
X=ok[cols]
y=ok.actual_min>ok.promised_min
X=pd.get_dummies(ok[cols+['courier','weather','shop_id']],dtype=int)
X_train,X_test,y_train,y_test=train_test_split(X,y,test_size=.25,random_state=42)
model=LogisticRegression(max_iter=2000).fit(X_train,y_train)
p=model.predict_proba(X_test)[:,1]
risk=pd.DataFrame({'p':p,'late':y_test})
top=risk.sort_values('p',ascending=False).head(int(len(risk)*.1))
top_rate=round(top.late.mean(),3)
all_rate=round(risk.late.mean(),3)
lift=round(top.late.mean()/risk.late.mean(),2)

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.tree import DecisionTreeClassifier, DecisionTreeRegressor
from sklearn.ensemble import RandomForestClassifier, RandomForestRegressor
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression, LinearRegression
from sklearn.metrics import accuracy_score, mean_absolute_error, mean_squared_error, r2_score
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split, cross_val_score, StratifiedKFold, KFold
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
d = pd.read_csv("deliveries.csv",parse_dates=["created"])
ok = d[d.actual_min.between(1,299)].copy()
ok['hour']=ok.created.dt.hour
cols=['distance_km','items','promised_min','hour']
X=ok[cols]
y=ok.actual_min>ok.promised_min
X=pd.get_dummies(ok[cols+['courier','weather','shop_id']],dtype=int)
X_train,X_test,y_train,y_test=train_test_split(X,y,test_size=.25,random_state=42)
model=LogisticRegression(max_iter=2000).fit(X_train,y_train)
p=model.predict_proba(X_test)[:,1]
risk=pd.DataFrame({'p':p,'late':y_test})
risk['group']=pd.cut(risk.p,[0,.25,.5,.75,1],include_lowest=True)
cal=risk.groupby('group',observed=True).agg(pred=('p','mean'),fact=('late','mean'),n=('p','size'))
assert cal.n.sum()==len(p)
worst=round((cal.pred-cal.fact).abs().max(),3)
